title: KPI cards overlap each other in a narrow desktop band
symptom: KPI cards were given a 300 px minimum width. In the four-column layout between 1440 px and ~1560 px wide the grid columns are narrower than that, so each card overlaps the one to its right by up to ~30 px, hiding the left edge of the next card. It does not appear at 1920 px or below 1440 px (two columns).
